styleLock.backgroundSystem: deep teal green #14524A for opening and closing banners, pale mist cyan #E1F3F1 and clean white #FFFFFF for info, detail and scene screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft diffused studio key with a cool rim light, glowing cyan airflow accents, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte seamless studio backdrop with clean white rounded info cards
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in deep teal #14524A or white #FFFFFF, all copy wrapped in 「」, no mixed fonts
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons with a single deep-teal #14524A stroke
styleLock.presentationRules: stable side-profile and slight 3/4 hero angles, consistent product scale across the set, centered stable layouts
noDrift: no airflow glow color drift outside the fixed cyan/amber/rose trio
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium personal-care tech visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep teal green #14524A, pale mist cyan #E1F3F1, clean white #FFFFFF and one amber accent #F5A623; soft diffused studio lighting with a cool rim light and soft contact shadows; glowing airflow rendered only in cyan #7FE0DC, amber #F5B041 or rose #E86A8A; modern geometric sans-serif headlines in deep teal or white; consistent white rounded info cards; consistent thin-line icon style in deep teal #14524A; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable side-profile and slight 3/4 hero product angles and scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
